descriptionChirho: Animal dung or manure, used almost exclusively in prophetic imagery of desolation and contempt where corpses or the wicked are compared to dung spread on the ground. All occurrences carry the same concrete referent whether preceded by a comparative preposition ('like dung') or standing alone. Eng 'dung', spa 'estiercol', hin 'gobar', arb 'rawth / dimn / diman', kor 'georeum', swa 'mbolea / samadi'.
